label: Bayesian track + measures
methodsText: {popsToTrack} cells were tracked with btrack (maximum search radius {maxSearchRadius}, gaps of up to {maxLost} frames, tracks of at least {minTimepoints} timepoints), and speed, displacement, straightness and shape measures were computed for each track.
purpose: Run Bayesian tracking, then Track measures
useWhen: The usual way to track: tracks arrive with speed, angle and displacement
Before HMM states, Cluster tracks or gating on track properties
notWhen: Tracks drift with the tissue: run Drift correction first
